summary: Keep fractal-web switch subscriptions in the switch trace; create independent first-frame roots only when no UX parent is active.

replay.detail: Client telemetry only; existing claims are not replayed.

schema.detail: No database schema or persisted claim format changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: The existing subscribe trace field is unchanged. The daemon tolerates but does not extract it; daemon first-frame spans remain independent roots linked to the WebSocket upgrade context.

downtime.detail: No service interruption is required for this client-only telemetry change.

manual.detail: Export remains opt-in through the explicitly configured endpoint; no relay, collector or server setup is added.

recovery.detail: No new rollback or roll-forward requirements; reverting restores the previous client span layout.
